metas.name: Dragon
metas.description: Set in 1967 around International Opium Trade by Afghan Trading Company and Golden Trading Company

metas.name: Eleventh
metas.description: Traumatized by his family’s death, a grieving detective investigating a fiery murder is tormented by a silent, familiar figure in the dark, forcing him to determine if he is hunting a killer or confronting a terrifying truth about himself.

metas.name: Salaar: Part 1 - Ceasefire
metas.description: The fate of a violently contested kingdom hangs on the fraught bond between two friends-turned-foes.

metas.name: Lucky Baskhar
metas.description: A middle-class bank clerk who longs to trade stability for adventure gets more than he bargained for when he unexpectedly becomes a wealthy man.

metas.name: HIT: The Third Case
metas.description: The Homicide Intervention Team (HIT) sends ruthless police officer Arjun Sarkaar to find a group of killers and stop their grisly murder spree.

metas.name: S. Saraswathi
metas.description: A devoted mother whose life is shattered when her 12-year-old daughter goes missing. Desperate for answers, she turns to the police for help, but as the investigation unfolds, unexpected twists begin to deepen the mystery.

metas.name: King
metas.description: After Coimbatore-based Ravichandra Verma passes away, his young son, Raja, assumes the responsibility of running the family business as well as ensuring that his brother, Ajay, gets a good education - much to the chagrin of three of his uncles. Years later, while on a trip to Uttaranchal, despite of warnings from a Pandit, he gets killed by a female assassin, but his family is informed that he is missing. Shortly thereafter, Gyaneshwar Kale and his sister, Sravani/Shivani, will inform the family that Raja is still alive but is handicapped and suffers from memory loss. The family is overjoyed but are not aware that Raja is actually a hoodlum/extortionist known as Bottu Seenu/Raghu Rokda.

metas.name: Court: State vs. A Nobody
metas.description: A determined lawyer takes on a high-stakes case to defend a 19-year-old boy, challenging a system that has already branded him guilty.

metas.name: Pokiri
metas.description: Pandu is a contract killer and will accept any contract provided the amount is right. The police want him for questioning, while the underworld needs him to silence their opponents. No one really knows this assassin's background. It is only Pandu who knows his real identity, and he has no intention of sharing it with anyone.

metas.name: HIT: The 2nd Case
metas.description: Krishna Dev aka KD, a laidback cop working in Andhra Pradesh State HIT, takes on a gruesome murder case. As KD unravels the layers of the crime, the stakes rise unbelievably high and the threat comes unusually close.

metas.name: Matka
metas.description: Set between the years 1958 and 1982, Matka tells the story of Vasu, who rises from poverty to create a powerful gambling empire in India, ultimately leading the nation into a battle with the government. Based on real events, the tale explores themes of love, moral choices, and the consequences of ambition.

metas.name: Kriyamana
metas.description: Kriyamana is a gripping crime thriller that explores how a single choice can set off a chain of events capable of changing lives forever. As secrets unravel and hidden motives come to light, the line between guilt and innocence begins to blur.

metas.name: Killer
metas.description: Priya, the niece of an assassinated prime minister, lives with her aunt and her cousin. She falls in love with Prem. Unfortunately, she is unaware of Prem's evil intentions.

metas.name: Plan B
metas.description: The story begins with the demise of a lawyer named Vishwanath and travels through multiple twists, suspense and turns without leaving a single clue for the police to find.

metas.name: Run Raja Run
metas.description: Raja, son of a vegetable vendor, is a simple man. His girlfriends dump him because of his honesty. However, things take a turn when he meets his true love Priya, the daughter of a police commissioner.

metas.name: Bhoothaddam Bhaskar Narayana
metas.description: A small town detective, entangled in a rash of unsolved murders spanning the past 18 years, searches for the truth.

metas.name: Evaru
metas.description: When a high-ranking police officer is killed by his alleged rape victim, Sub-inspector Vikram Vasudev is entrusted with investigating what seems like an open-and-shut case. However, as he delves deeper, Vikram finds the case spiralling into a dark tale filled with unexpected surprises.

metas.name: Mrithyunjay
metas.description: An intense murder investigation unfolds when a man refuses to accept a death casually deemed natural by the police. As he digs deeper, what begins as doubt turns into a relentless pursuit of truth, uncovering layers of deception and danger

metas.name: Kuberaa
metas.description: A ruthless billionaire, Neeraj, uses beggars as benamis to launder money, with the help of a disgraced civil submit servant, Deepak. One of the beggars, Deva, escapes with ₹10,000 crores and becomes the target of a deadly manhunt. He meets Sameera, who joins him in his mission to use the money to uplift society's poor. With Deepak's help, Deva fights back.

metas.name: Goodachari
metas.description: Gopi, is the son of an ex-RAW agent Raghuveer. Brought up by his uncle Sathya, he wants to be an agent just like his father and uncle. But Satya wants him to lead a normal life and not be killed like his father was. What happens in Gopi’s life that turns everything upside down?

metas.name: Julayi
metas.description: An intelligent young man and a timid cop team up to catch a criminal who wants revenge after a foiled bank robbery.

metas.name: Paramapadha Sopanam
metas.description: Sarpanch, VRO, and medical officer-begin to meet brutal ends, each shrouded in secrecy.Police investigation reveals thirty fingerprints on bodies of deceased, but only one fingerprint is found on the last victim, creating a complex puzzle.

metas.name: Daaku Maharaaj
metas.description: A violent outlaw takes a job as a personal driver in order to protect the life of a little girl.

metas.name: Mufti Police
metas.description: When writer Jeba is murdered at midnight, the calm of an upscale apartment complex shatters. Inspector Magudapathi, known for his unorthodox methods, delves into the residents' secrets to uncover the truth. Amid the chaos, Adhi`s growing bond with his mother's therapist, Meera, complicates everything. Mufti Police is a tense thriller where every neighbor hides a motive and the truth is darker than anyone expects.

metas.name: Yashoda
metas.description: Looking to save her sister, Yashoda, a desperate woman agrees to be a surrogate and move in to a plush facility - but nothing is as it seems. In the world outside Eva, a Hollywood starlet dies under mysterious circumstances, so do a tycoon and a super model. An unknown drug seem to hold the key to the whole mystery.

metas.name: Project MD
metas.description: "MD" (Molchat Doma) lives by a simple rule: transport the money, take the cut, and never get involved in anything that costs lives. But when a routine delivery goes horribly wrong, MD and his closest friend Naag find themselves trapped in a dangerous web of crime, betrayal, and hidden agendas. Forced to work for a powerful underworld figure "Raghu Pratap" while uncovering secrets connected to the mysterious death, the two are pulled deeper into a world far bigger than they ever imagined. As loyalties are tested and the line between friend and enemy begins to blur, MD must decide how far he's willing to go and whether he can survive the game.

metas.name: DJ: Duvvada Jagannadham
metas.description: A righteous young man who helps everyone gain their rightful justice, gets recruited as an undercover agent to work on a high profile case that involves a crime lord working for a corrupt minister who also happens to be the father of his romantic interest.

metas.name: Student No. 1
metas.description: At his father's request, Aditya attends a law college in the coastal metropolis of Visakhapatnam, although he actually wanted to become an engineer. On the first day he meets the beautiful Anjali. Over time, the female student slowly begins to become interested in the strange newcomer, who acts nice and friendly but doesn't seem to be interested in anything else. The college is notorious for its disobediently and disorderly students. It's not the professors who are in charge on campus, but rather the student leader Satya. He is also in love with Anjali and sees Aditya as a competitor who needs to be put in his place. So Aditya faces multiple problems as he tries to reform the unruly students while dealing with his terrible past that everyone doesn't know about.

metas.name: Temper
metas.description: Daya is a corrupt cop who joins hands with the local don. When Daya's girlfriend gets kidnapped, it triggers Daya to go against Vasu and his empire, leading him to uncover a bigger motive behind the kidnapping.

metas.name: DJ Tillu
metas.description: When a local DJ and his affair with a young woman put him square in the middle of a crime, he must do his best to get out of the predicament he’s in.
